description:
The tote you’ll grab every time you head out the door. Most tote bags are flimsy, awkward to carry, or just plain ugly. This one is thick, sturdy, and thoughtfully designed.

Heavyweight 100% cotton canvas
Shoulder strap and grab handles
Two interior pockets to keep your small items organized
Snap closure keeps everything secure

Features:

Heavyweight 100% cotton canvas 
Shoulder strap and grab handles
Two interior pockets 
Snap closure
Dimensions: 12" x 15" x 3" (excluding handles)
Shoulder strap: 31" long
name: Ugmonk Utility Tote (Field Tan)
